text:
Marta Lopez: Heads up — NimbusAI is scheduled for dedicated pool bring-up next Tue. Need final sync on quota plan, autoscale thresholds, and the smoke load test script. Who can own the quota numbers?
Ajay Patel: I can take quota calc. Can y'all share expected qps and token mix?
Marta Lopez: Customer provided profile: 120 RPS peak, ~30 tokens/gen average, 20% chat use (multi-turn), 80% single-shot. They want < 150ms median gen latency.
Samir Khan: For 120 RPS at 30 tokens that's ~3600 tokens/s. With our baseline model X quant profile, expect ~45 tps per GPU. So ~80 GPUs for headroom unless we enable batching + KV cache.
Dina Cho: We recommended caching for session-heavy flows — can reduce GPU need ~25%. Also suggest burst quota for first 72h.
Ajay Patel: Ok. My draft quota: reserve 60 GPUs baseline, burst pool 20, autoscale step 5 GPUs, cool-down 60s. Will post the numbers in a minute.
Marta Lopez: @Samir can you confirm autoscale step/cooldown match runtime limits? Last time step=10 blew over by slow startup.
Samir Khan: Confirmed — runtime cold-start ~12s per GPU for that instance type. Step=5 & cooldown=60s safe. Also add capacity bump policy: if error_rate > 2% for 3m, add 10 GPUs immediately.
Dina Cho: For load tests we should simulate: 1) steady 120 RPS 2) spike to 240 RPS for 10m 3) chat-heavy 80 RPS with KV reuse. I can author the k6 script.
Marta Lopez: Please include ramp-up phases and header metadata to exercise routing (customer_id header). Ops needs that to route to reserved pool.
Ajay Patel: Draft quota JSON (for ops-ticket):
```
{
  "customer": "nimbusai",
  "baseline_gpus": "60",
  "burst_gpus": "20",
  "autoscale_step": "5",
  "autoscale_cooldown_s": "60",
  "error_bump_policy": "if_errors_gt_2pct_3m_add_10"
}
```
Samir Khan: Looks good. Add region pin to us-west-2 and a max_gpus cap of 100.
Ajay Patel: Updated snippet: added region/max.
Dina Cho: k6 snippet for spike (pseudo):
```
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';

export default function() {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.demo/generate', JSON.stringify({input: '...'}), { headers: { 'x-customer-id': 'nimbusai' } });
  sleep(0.01);
}
```
Will parameterize payload sizes.
Marta Lopez: Ops runbook items: 1) Pre-warm cache with 1h synthetic session replay 2) Enable socket keepalive 3) Increase request timeout to 45s for long chat runs. Samir can you add runtime hooks?
Samir Khan: Will add hooks. Also will add alert channel: #customer-success + pager to oncall if error_rate > 5% for 5m.
ops-bot: deploy-ticket #D-789 created by @Ajay Patel — assigned to @eng-oncall. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/D-789
Marta Lopez: Great. Next steps: Ajay finalize quota JSON and post in the ticket by EOD, Dina share k6 scripts, Samir produce runtime hook PR & alerts. I'll schedule a 30m pre-run check on Monday.
Ajay Patel: On it, will upload to ticket and ping when ready.
Dina Cho: k6 repo link once ready: https://git.redwood/k6/nimbus-loadtests — I'll include test matrix.
Samir Khan: PR will be up by tonight.
Marta Lopez: Thanks team :thumbsup:
